subject.title: fix(diagnostics): reclaim zombie embedded-run counters left idle by handle-mismatch clears

question: Should OpenClaw reclaim idle, no-queue sessions that still have active embedded-run diagnostic activity by routing them through active-abort recovery after stuckSessionAbortMs?
rationale: This is a real P1 session-stall mitigation, but it intentionally changes recovery behavior for idle session state and must be reconciled with newer recovery changes and adjacent stale-run fixes before merge.

options.title: Refresh And Land Bounded Recovery
options.body: Rebase the branch, preserve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94701's progress-age invariant, rerun focused diagnostics validation, and accept the active-abort mitigation for stale idle embedded-run bookkeeping.

options.title: Pause For Root-Cause Prevention
options.body: Hold this PR until a live Slack reproduction or a narrower prevention fix proves why the active-run counter is leaked.

options.title: Replace With Dispatch-Liveness Fix
options.body: Use the adjacent dispatch-routing approach if maintainers prefer preventing stale active-run presence from blocking inbound delivery instead of expanding diagnostic recovery.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land Bounded Recovery
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, preserve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94701's progress-age invariant, rerun focused diagnostics validation, and accept the active-abort mitigation for stale idle embedded-run bookkeeping.
